git_blob_comparison.method: relative path and raw git blob SHA-1 compared with each recorded upstream commit
git_blob_comparison.line_ending_conversion: disabled during final git archive export

staged_index_comparison.method: staged blob SHA-1 and Git file mode compared with the exact upstream archives

limitations: Only selected skill paths and their support files were copied from large upstream repositories.
The validation establishes identity with recorded git blobs, not safety or fitness for use.
The paper-skills project is referenced as a git submodule because no redistribution license was found.
